name: Gi21 Capital

entity_kind.quote: Gi21 Capital is a multi-stage investment group bridging the gap between entrepreneurial agility and institutional-grade scale.

investor_type.quote: Gi21 has evolved from a family office into a founder-first firm driven by an operator’s DNA. We built the vehicle I wish I’d had at 17, one that offers the speed of a founder and the patience of permanent capital. By investing our own money, we eliminate LP pressure

investments.quote: JIC Ventures vstúpil do investičného kola Series A spoločnosti FaceUp v hodnote 5 miliónov dolárov. Kolo viedol chorvátsky fond Fil Rouge Capital. Pridali sa aj slovenský Venture to Future Fund, pražský Gi21 Capital
Zerops, a Prague-based developer of a cloud platform that builds, deploys, and manages apps, has raised $500,000 in a pre-Seed investment round backed by Presto Ventures and Gi21 Capital.

notes: Prague investment group of founder Damir Špoljarič investing own (permanent) capital; also runs AI data-center infrastructure, hospitality and arts activities, so classified private_investor (could be seen as family_office). Website claims 25+ companies backed and 6 exits. No Slovak investment found; FaceUp is Czech. Ticket sizes and AUM not published.

sectors.quote: Backing technical founders solving complex problems through Deep Tech, B2B SaaS, AI.
